But he was dismayed to learn that not only had the body he transmigrated to been incredibly weak and untalented, but the act of swordfighting was heavily looked down upon. the-football-agent-system:
They stole his players.
They ruined his name.
They made sure he would never work in football again.
Gabriel Garcia was once a rising football agent, but after being betrayed by the agency he served for six years, he lost everything—his clients, his reputation, his career, and his place in the football world.
Then, at his lowest point, a screen appeared before his eyes.
[Career System Activated.]
[Path Selected: Football Agent.]
His first mission was simple.
[Mission: Register as an independent football agent.]
Then came the next.
[Mission: Sign your first player.]
And after that—
[Mission: Get your client signed to a professional club.]
Garcia’s reputation is ruined. His network is damaged. His influence is zero.

***
